DECLARE @FileDate DATE =
(
    SELECT TOP 1
        CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8))
    FROM D360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCARDP
);

DECLARE @PrevDate DATE;
SELECT @PrevDate=PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE = @FileDate

DECLARE @FILENAME VARCHAR(100) = (
    SELECT TOP 1
        FILE_NAME
    FROM D360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXCARDP
);

        insert_dttm

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.CCD_Date=dd.previous_business_day
    and dd.business_day_flag=''Y''')
